headline_marked: Uranium shipment [[lands in Bangladesh]] for Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant
headline: Uranium shipment lands in Bangladesh for Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant
summary: The fuel arrives on a Russian cargo flight after being delayed due to airspace clearance issues with Pakistan.
details: A special cargo flight carrying uranium for the first unit of the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant landed in Dhaka around 11:45 pm on Friday.
The shipment is intended to refuel the first unit of the country's only nuclear power plant.
The delivery was originally scheduled for September 24 but was delayed after Pakistan initially refused to grant permission for the flight to use its airspace.
Science and Technology Minister Faqir Mahbub Anam stated that the clearance from Pakistan was expected to be granted as it had been in the past, attributing the delay to a possible gap in approval.
The uranium arrived on board a Russian-made four-engine Ilyushin Il-76 aircraft.
caption:
Uranium for the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant has finally arrived in Dhaka after a diplomatic delay.

A special cargo flight carrying uranium for the first unit of the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant landed in Dhaka around 11:45 pm on Friday.

The shipment is intended to refuel the first unit of the country's only nuclear power plant.

The delivery was originally scheduled for September 24 but was delayed after Pakistan initially refused to grant permission for the flight to use its airspace.

Science and Technology Minister Faqir Mahbub Anam stated that the clearance from Pakistan was expected to be granted as it had been in the past, attributing the delay to a possible gap in approval.

The uranium arrived on board a Russian-made four-engine Ilyushin Il-76 aircraft.

Source: Jamuna TV, bdnews24.com

headline_marked: bdnews24.com Editor [[Toufique Imrose Khalidi dies]] at 59
headline: bdnews24.com Editor Toufique Imrose Khalidi dies at 59
summary: The trailblazing journalist is remembered as a visionary who helped establish round-the-clock digital news publishing in Bangladesh.
details: Toufique Imrose Khalidi, the Editor-in-Chief of bdnews24.com, has passed away at the age of 59. He is hailed as a pioneer of online journalism in Bangladesh.
The Online Editors Forum described him as an experienced, dedicated, and visionary journalist who made significant contributions to the country's media landscape.
Under his leadership, bdnews24.com adopted a new format in 2006, helping to advance the practice of round-the-clock news publishing in the country.
Khalidi's career spanned print, broadcast, and digital media, with a focus on politics, economics, development, and international affairs.
He previously worked for a broadsheet newspaper in Bangladesh and later with the BBC in the UK, bringing professional skill and international experience to his work.
The President of Bangladesh and other media peers have expressed their condolences, noting that his uncompromising journalism and legacy will be long remembered.
caption:
A pioneer of Bangladeshi online journalism has passed away. Toufique Imrose Khalidi, Editor-in-Chief of bdnews24.com, dies at 59.

Toufique Imrose Khalidi, the Editor-in-Chief of bdnews24.com, has passed away at the age of 59. He is hailed as a pioneer of online journalism in Bangladesh.

The Online Editors Forum described him as an experienced, dedicated, and visionary journalist who made significant contributions to the country's media landscape.

Under his leadership, bdnews24.com adopted a new format in 2006, helping to advance the practice of round-the-clock news publishing in the country.

Khalidi's career spanned print, broadcast, and digital media, with a focus on politics, economics, development, and international affairs.

He previously worked for a broadsheet newspaper in Bangladesh and later with the BBC in the UK, bringing professional skill and international experience to his work.

The President of Bangladesh and other media peers have expressed their condolences, noting that his uncompromising journalism and legacy will be long remembered.

#Bangladesh #Journalism #bdnews24 #ToufiqueKhalidi #MediaNews

Source: Dhaka Tribune, bdnews24.com, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
